items.context:
Let me get this right… #ElderScrollsOnline has home decorating, clothes-making, harvesting flowers, pets, and fishing? This is a cozy game for the girlies!!!
image: an orc in a long robe standing in a roughly decorated room with sparkles and hearts
items.text: ESO really does have a surprising amount of housing, crafting and fishing for anyone who wants a slower pace.
